description: Which timers a test sees on jest-environment-jsdom: each test's title holds `typeof` of `setImmediate`, `clearImmediate`, `MessageChannel` and `queueMicrotask`, and whether the global's `setTimeout`, `setInterval` and `clearTimeout` are the window's own. jest-environment-jsdom gives the test the window as its global, and the window has no `setImmediate`.
